snippet.title: Evercade - Roguecraft DX - Trailer
snippet.description:
The modern Amiga hit, winner of the Retro World Award at the 2025 Debug Indie Game Awards, comes to Evercade in an all-new expanded, enhanced form!

For time immemorial, legend has told of a dark, deadly dungeon containing unimaginable horrors and riches beyond belief. Dive into that dungeon and seek your fortune with this all-new deluxe version of Roguecraft for Evercade!

Release: August 2025
Pre-order from May 30, 2025

Find out more: https://www.evercade.co.uk/cartridges/roguecraft-dx/
